player_prompt.intro:
I ye jokelani {player_id} o SimpleTak.
O tabulo la, o maana ye kɛlɛkɛw '{player_stone}' ne o tɛmɛnw ye kɛlɛkɛw '{opponent_stone}'.

I ye wele, i ka kɛlɛkɛ ye kɔnɔ (kɔnɔ o laama) ne i daa o laama kɔnɔ.
Saba, '[12]' daa o laama kɔnɔ 12.

O jamana ye kɛlɛkɛw ye kɔnɔ o maana ye kɛlɛkɛw kɛ o tabulo kɔnɔ kɛ (kɛnɛyɛrɛ-ɲɛgɛrɛn o tabulo kɔnɔ).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Kɛlɛkɛ ye kɔnɔ {cell_num} ye sɔrɔ. Ye bɛɛ don min bɛ 0 ne {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sɛli {cell_num} ye sɔrɔ ka ban. I sɛlili dɔ sugandi k'a kɛ lakolon ye.

action.placement: Jokelani {current_player_id} daa o laama so ({symbol}) kɔnɔ {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Jɔgɔ {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') da cɛma kaɲɔgɔn de bɛɛ la!
outcome.draw: A laban ye bɛnbaliya lo ye!
